_comment: WP-20: reviewed exceptions of scripts/tokens/check-coverage.mjs. `backgrounds`: colour tokens used as a background on which no text is drawn (bars, dots, handles, overlays, image mats), so they need no text pair. `themeMechanism`: file:reason for code that still reads or sets the theme outside the store, with the package that removes it. Add an entry only with a reason a reviewer can check.

backgrounds.scrim: the dimmed layer behind a dialog; the dialog's own surface carries the text
backgrounds.image-backdrop: white mat behind pictures and thumbnails (fixed token, the picture is the content)
backgrounds.border-default: disabled-control edge colour; states.css uses it as a border, the regex sees the shorthand
backgrounds.ctx-line: the 2px underline of the active contextual ribbon tab
backgrounds.doc-change-modify: 3px change bar in the document margin
backgrounds.doc-change-add: 3px change bar in the document margin
backgrounds.doc-change-delete: 3px change bar in the document margin
backgrounds.doc-selection: the picture resize handle (--sel), a 10px square
backgrounds.export-canvas: the area behind the printed pages in the export view; the pages are paper
backgrounds.viewer-highlight: pdf.js search highlight over the canvas-drawn page: the visible text is pixels, the text layer is transparent
backgrounds.viewer-text-select: pdf.js selection over the canvas-drawn page (same as viewer-highlight)
backgrounds.pdf-annot-comment: P3-4 PDF review highlight over the canvas-drawn page (same as viewer-highlight); also the 10px type swatch in the Comments panel
backgrounds.pdf-annot-suggestion: P3-4 PDF review highlight over the canvas-drawn page (same as viewer-highlight); also the 10px type swatch
backgrounds.pdf-annot-remark: P3-4 PDF review highlight over the canvas-drawn page (same as viewer-highlight); also the 10px type swatch
backgrounds.pdf-annot-closed: P3-4 PDF review highlight of a closed thread over the canvas-drawn page (same as viewer-highlight)
backgrounds.pdf-annot-draft: P3-4 PDF review: the dashed box of a selection or area being commented, over the canvas-drawn page
backgrounds.danger: the severity dot of an error finding (.v2-sev.error, .jss-pr .sev.error), a non-text mark; text on a red fill uses danger-solid
backgrounds.warning: the severity dot of a warning finding (.v2-sev.warn, .jss-pr .sev.warning) and the unsaved dot, non-text marks; text on an amber fill uses warning-solid
backgrounds.border-control: the neutral .dot, the off track of .switch and the empty .stackbar segment (components.css): non-text marks
backgrounds.success: the .dot.success status mark beside its label (components.css)
backgrounds.text-link: the .dot.accent status mark beside its label (components.css)
backgrounds.info: the severity dot of an info finding (.v2-sev.info), a non-text mark; info/surface-panel is paired as text

themeMechanism.main.tsx: the store's wiring: applies the stored choice at start and follows the OS while the choice is 'system' (part of the theme owner)
themeMechanism.studio/ui/app.ts: the Studio's standalone mode sets the attribute only when no platform host is present (`if (!this.host)`); inside the shell the host decides. Removed with the editor host contract (WP-21)
